title: Grade Classifier
scenario: A teacher has a student's final score between 0 and 100. She wants the grade in one of five buckets: 90 or above is A, 80 to 89 is B, 70 to 79 is C, 60 to 69 is D, and below 60 is F. What Python construct walks a single value through these checks and stops at the first match?
